claims.statement: For the exact bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 full-production challenge and encodings fixed by the protected profile reproduced in proof.md, the complete classical Shanks construction in proof.md and arithmetic.md returns the required output with success probability 1 over all valid challenge inputs. Its full cold total scalar AArch64 instruction-equivalent work divided by the fixed normalization C has log2 at most 162. Peak total memory is bounded by 2^151 bytes under the explicitly declared finite local-link machine model; all initialization, arithmetic, transfer, sorting/lookup, input/output and verification work is charged. No practical attack, novelty, improvement, reward or previous acceptance is claimed.
